title: El Obeid Fuel Station, Aid Truck, and School Struck in Single Day
detail: An RSF drone strike on a fuel station in central El Obeid killed 1 and wounded 4 on June 26, 2026. Separately, a humanitarian truck delivering aid was attacked, killing the driver, and a SAF drone strike hit a school, injuring 8 students. The trio of strikes underscored the deteriorating protection environment for civilian and humanitarian infrastructure in North Kordofan as the siege of El Obeid intensified through late June.

title: US Treasury Sanctions 8 Individuals, Entities for 'Fueling' Sudan's War
detail: The US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) announced sanctions on June 26, 2026 against 8 individuals and entities accused of fueling Sudan's civil war: a Sudan-based defense enterprise supplying explosives and military equipment to the SAF, an India-based explosives manufacturer and its CEO, and three individuals tied to a Panama-based company recruiting Colombian fighters for the RSF. Treasury urged an 'immediate, unconditional' three-month humanitarian truce, signaling continued US pressure on both belligerents' external supply networks ahead of the broader US-brokered peace framework pushed by envoy Massad Boulos.
